item.coloph: 'dul ba dri ba'i tshig le'u byas pa'i gtan la dbab pa/ slob dpon mdo sde 'dzin pa ka l+yA pA mi tras mdzad pa rdzogs so/ gal te bdag ni rmongs pa yis/ lan zhig legs par ma theb na/ 'di ni phyogs tsam bstan par byas/ mkhas pas bde legs gdab du gsol/ sdug cing gdung ba sel byas pa/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster/ sgrib ma sdug po'i shing mchog ltar/ gzhan don dga' ba'i phyir 'khrungs ba/ kun dga' go chas bdag la ni/ shin tu bcol te de yi phyir/ ci dran pa zhig 'bad de byas/ nga rgyal gyi ni phyir ma yin/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po d+harmA ka ra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la dbab pa/ sh+lau ka stong drug brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi yod do
